# Synapse Network MCP Server

Synapse Network Remote MCP lets AI agents discover payable APIs, invoke approved paid tools with bounded USDC spend, and retrieve settlement receipts.

- Remote MCP endpoint: https://mcp.synapse-network.ai/mcp
- Tools: discover_services, invoke_and_pay, get_receipt
- GitHub: https://github.com/SynapseNetworkAI/Synapse-Network-MCP-Server
- npm: @synapse-network-ai/mcp-server
- Docs: https://docs.synapse-network.ai/mcp/paid-api-calls

Synapse does not expose raw customer agent credentials to public listings.
